# Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` at the repo root first; its golden rules apply to every change.

- Team rules: `.claude/rules/*.md` (plain Markdown, they apply to every tool).
- Facts: `docs/context/`, one topic per file; open only what the task needs.
- Skills (procedures), when exported: `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`.
- Shared agent state and hand-off: `.agents/`.
- Before saying done, follow `docs/context/SELF_REVIEW.md` and `docs/context/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md`.
